hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information diffusion across market participants occurs with delay, causing medium-term top performers to outperform bottom performers.
hypotheses.rebalance_rule: Every 5 trading days on market close (strictly non-overlapping periods)
hypotheses.ranking_rule: Sort eligible constituents by R_i_20 in descending order
hypotheses.portfolio_rule: Long Top Tercile (Top 3 stocks, equal-weighted 33.33% each); Short Bottom Tercile (Bottom 3 stocks, equal-weighted 33.33% each)
hypotheses.eligibility_rule: Constituent must be active member of VERIFIED_NIFTY_CONSTITUENT_SUBSET with valid Close for all 20 lookback days
hypotheses.cost_model: IndianEquityCostModel (STT=0.1% buy/sell, Exchange=0.00345%, SEBI=0.0001%, Stamp=0.015% buy, GST=18%, Brokerage=0.03% assumption, Slippage=5bps assumption)
hypotheses.missing_data_rule: If any constituent has missing Close in lookback window, it is disqualified from ranking for that period
hypotheses.timestamp_rule: Feature timestamp strictly t (Close of rebalance day); Forward return timestamp strictly t+1 to t+5

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-term extreme price moves driven by liquidity provision imbalances and retail overreaction tend to partially reverse over subsequent sessions.
hypotheses.rebalance_rule: Every 5 trading days on market close (strictly non-overlapping periods)
hypotheses.ranking_rule: Sort eligible constituents by R_i_5 in ascending order (lowest return first)
hypotheses.portfolio_rule: Long Top Tercile losers (Bottom 3 stocks by 5d return, equal-weighted); Short Top Tercile gainers (Top 3 stocks by 5d return, equal-weighted)
hypotheses.eligibility_rule: Constituent must have valid Close for all 5 lookback days
hypotheses.missing_data_rule: Disqualify symbol if any price in 5-day lookback is missing
hypotheses.timestamp_rule: Feature calculated strictly at t; Forward return strictly t+1 to t+5

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Scaling momentum by realized historical volatility eliminates uncompensated idiosyncratic noise and improves signal information ratio.
hypotheses.rebalance_rule: Every 5 trading days on market close
hypotheses.ranking_rule: Sort eligible constituents by VolAdjMom_i in descending order
hypotheses.portfolio_rule: Long Top Tercile (Top 3 stocks, equal-weighted); Short Bottom Tercile (Bottom 3 stocks, equal-weighted)
hypotheses.eligibility_rule: Constituent must have full 20 daily return observations
hypotheses.missing_data_rule: Disqualify symbol if standard deviation cannot be computed over 20 days
hypotheses.timestamp_rule: Feature calculated strictly at t; Forward return strictly t+1 to t+5

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Price momentum accompanied by abnormal turnover reflects institutional conviction and sustained order flow rather than thin-volume drift.
hypotheses.feature_formula: R_i_20 = (Close_i_t / Close_i_t-20) - 1.0; VolumeRatio_i = Volume_i_t / (mean(Volume_i_t-20:t-1)). Note: Denominator strictly excludes Volume_i_t (point-in-time trailing 20 days prior to today).
hypotheses.rebalance_rule: Every 5 trading days on market close
hypotheses.ranking_rule: Winner: R_i_20 in Top Tercile AND VolumeRatio_i > 1.2. Loser: R_i_20 in Bottom Tercile AND VolumeRatio_i > 1.2.
hypotheses.portfolio_rule: Long confirmed winners (equal-weighted); Short confirmed losers (equal-weighted). If no symbol qualifies on a leg, that leg holds cash (0.0% return).
hypotheses.eligibility_rule: Constituent must have 21 days of volume and 20 days of price data
hypotheses.missing_data_rule: Exclude symbol if volume history is incomplete
hypotheses.timestamp_rule: Feature calculated strictly at t; Forward return strictly t+1 to t+5

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Stocks that demonstrate consistent relative outperformance against the market across both short (20d) and medium (60d) horizons reflect durable multi-horizon strength.
hypotheses.feature_formula: RS20_i = R_i_20 - R_NIFTY_20; RS60_i = R_i_60 - R_NIFTY_60; Score_i = Rank(RS20_i) + Rank(RS60_i)
hypotheses.rebalance_rule: Every 10 trading days on market close
hypotheses.ranking_rule: Sort eligible constituents by Score_i in descending order
hypotheses.portfolio_rule: Long Top Tercile (Top 3 stocks, equal-weighted); Short Bottom Tercile (Bottom 3 stocks, equal-weighted)
hypotheses.eligibility_rule: Constituent must have 60 days of clean price data aligned with benchmark NIFTY 50
hypotheses.missing_data_rule: Exclude symbol if 60-day history is incomplete
hypotheses.timestamp_rule: Feature calculated strictly at t; Forward return strictly t+1 to t+10

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Cross-sectional momentum operates effectively during constructive market breadth expansions, but experiences severe crashes during breadth deterioration.
hypotheses.feature_formula: Breadth_pct = mean(Close_i_t > SMA50_i_t across eligible universe) * 100.0. Condition: If Breadth_pct > 50.0%: execute Momentum (Long Top Tercile, Short Bottom Tercile). If Breadth_pct <= 50.0%: 100% Cash (0% exposure).
hypotheses.rebalance_rule: Every 5 trading days on market close
hypotheses.ranking_rule: Conditioned on aggregate breadth > 50%; within qualifying dates, sort by R_i_20 descending
hypotheses.portfolio_rule: Active: Long Top Tercile (3 stocks), Short Bottom Tercile (3 stocks); Inactive: 100% Cash
hypotheses.eligibility_rule: Requires 50-day SMA for breadth calculation and 20-day return for ranking
hypotheses.cost_model: IndianEquityCostModel (zero friction on inactive cash periods)
hypotheses.missing_data_rule: Breadth computed over constituents with valid 50-day history
hypotheses.timestamp_rule: Breadth and return calculated strictly at t; Forward return strictly t+1 to t+5
